prompt:
Bug: a food or unit whose description is NULL in the database breaks the API.

Foods and units created by older versions or by imports can have a NULL description column. Reading one fails: the IngredientFood and IngredientUnit schemas declare description as a string, so validating such a row raises a pydantic ValidationError.

Expected: IngredientFood.model_validate(row) and IngredientUnit.model_validate(row) accept a row whose description is None and give description == ""; a non-empty description is kept as it is.

Tests: `python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/unit_tests` for quick loops; the whole backend suite is `python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests` (about 9 minutes).
title: fix: coerce null food/unit description to empty string (#8309)
